title: Interstellar — A father's promise

hook.quote: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
hook.context: Sobiq uchuvchi Cooper insoniyat yangi uy izlashi kerakligini aytadi. "was never meant to" — "... uchun yaratilmagan edi" ma'nosidagi passiv ibora.

reading: In the near future, dust storms have been destroying crops for years. Farmers have been fighting a war they cannot win, and the world is slowly running out of food.

Cooper used to be a pilot for NASA. Now he works as a farmer and lives with his two children. His daughter Murph has been noticing strange signs in her bedroom: books fall from the shelves for no reason.
The signs lead Cooper to a secret NASA base. Scientists there have been working on a plan to save humanity. They have found a wormhole near Saturn that leads to another galaxy.
Cooper agrees to fly the mission, but Murph is furious. He promises her that he will come back, even though he doesn't know when.

On the first planet, time runs differently because of a huge black hole. One hour there equals seven years on Earth. When the team returns to the ship, their colleague has been waiting for them for twenty-three years.
Back on Earth, Murph has grown up and become a scientist. She has been trying to solve the equation that could save everyone.
Cooper falls into the black hole and discovers that he can send a message to Murph across time. The strange signs in her room were from him all along.

grammar.title: Present Perfect Continuous
explain: **have/has been + -ing** — o'tmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha **davom etayotgan** jarayon: Scientists **have been working** on a plan for years.
Ko'pincha **for / since / how long** bilan: **How long have** you **been waiting**? — I**'ve been waiting** for an hour.
Hozirgi ko'rinadigan natija: You're tired. — Yes, I**'ve been running**. (Yugurish endi tugagan, lekin izi bor.)

Continuous bilan farqi: I **have read** the book (tugatdim, natija) / I **have been reading** the book (jarayon, hali tugamagan bo'lishi mumkin). Holat fe'llari (know, like, own) continuous olmaydi: I've **known** him for years.

exercises.q: Scientists ___ on the plan for ten years.
exercises.why: for + hozirgacha davom → Present Perfect Continuous.

exercises.q: How long ___ you been learning English?
exercises.why: Savol: How long have you been + -ing?

exercises.q: Murph ___ strange signs since she was a child.
Your eyes are red. ___ you been crying?
exercises.why: Hozirgi natija sababi: Have you been crying?
